package model

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"
)

// Every constructor is compared against the mapping a person would have
// written, member for member. Not a golden file: a golden file says the output
// has not changed, and what makes a constructor right is that it moves the
// values a person meant to move.

func byHandPerson(src *User) Person {
	return Person{
		ID:       src.ID,
		Email:    src.Email,
		Age:      src.Age,
		FullName: src.FullName(),
		Nickname: src.NickName(),
	}
}

func TestPersonAgreesWithTheHandWrittenOne(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 7, Email: "a@b", Age: 40}
	if got, want := PersonFromUser(&src), byHandPerson(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

// reader is a Reader the test brings, since an interface holds no values of
// its own.
type reader struct {
	id    int
	label string
}

func (r reader) ID() int       { return r.id }
func (r reader) Label() string { return r.label }

func byHandCard(src Reader) Card {
	return Card{ID: src.ID(), Label: src.Label()}
}

func TestCardAgreesWithTheHandWrittenOne(t *testing.T) {
	src := reader{id: 3, label: "ace"}
	if got, want := CardFromReader(src), byHandCard(src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandRenamed(src *User) Renamed {
	return Renamed{ID: src.ID, Moniker: src.Email}
}

func TestTheHintSettlesRenamed(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 5, Email: "m@n", Age: 1}
	if got, want := RenamedFromUser(&src), byHandRenamed(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandConverted(src *User) Converted {
	return Converted{Age: float64(src.Age)}
}

func TestTheHintConvertsConverted(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{Age: 33}
	if got, want := ConvertedFromUser(&src), byHandConverted(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandTitled(src *Entitled) Titled {
	return Titled{ID: src.ID, title: src.Title}
}

func TestTheLocalUnexportedMemberIsMoved(t *testing.T) {
	src := Entitled{ID: 2, Title: "dr"}
	if got, want := TitledFromEntitled(&src), byHandTitled(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandSparse(src *Terse) Sparse {
	return Sparse{ID: src.ID}
}

func TestTheIgnoredMemberStaysZero(t *testing.T) {
	src := Terse{ID: 9}
	if got, want := SparseFromTerse(&src), byHandSparse(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandRolodexFromAccount(src *Account) Rolodex {
	return Rolodex{ID: src.ID, Email: src.Contact}
}

func TestTheTagPicksTheAccountMember(t *testing.T) {
	src := Account{ID: 4, Contact: "c@d"}
	if got, want := RolodexFromAccount(&src), byHandRolodexFromAccount(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandRolodexFromCompany(src *Company) Rolodex {
	return Rolodex{ID: src.ID, Email: src.EmailAddress}
}

func TestTheTagPicksTheCompanyMember(t *testing.T) {
	src := Company{ID: 6, EmailAddress: "e@f"}
	if got, want := RolodexFromCompany(&src), byHandRolodexFromCompany(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandBadge(src *User) Badge {
	return Badge{Name: src.NickName(), Contact: src.Email}
}

func TestTheTagPinsAMethodAndABareMember(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 8, Email: "g@h"}
	if got, want := BadgeFromUser(&src), byHandBadge(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandCored(src *Rooted) Cored {
	return Cored{Core: src.Core, Label: src.Label}
}

func TestTheTagReachesAPromotedMember(t *testing.T) {
	src := Rooted{Base: Base{Core: 12}, Label: "root"}
	if got, want := CoredFromRooted(&src), byHandCored(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandPoached(src *Rich) Poached {
	return Poached{Email: src.Contact}
}

func TestTheTagDisplacesTheExactMatch(t *testing.T) {
	src := Rich{Email: "no", Contact: "yes"}
	if got, want := PoachedFromRich(&src), byHandPoached(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

// The fused writers are held to construct-then-encode, byte for byte and
// verdict for verdict: whatever AppendJSON writes for the built value is what
// the fusion must write with no value built.

func fusedAgainst(t *testing.T, name string, got []byte, gotErr error, want []byte, wantErr error) {
	t.Helper()

	if (gotErr == nil) != (wantErr == nil) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: fused err = %v, construct-then-encode err = %v", name, gotErr, wantErr)
	}
	if string(got) != string(want) {
		t.Errorf("%s: fused wrote %s, want %s", name, got, want)
	}
}

func writtenAgainst(t *testing.T, name string, n int64, err error, buf *bytes.Buffer, want []byte) {
	t.Helper()

	if err != nil || n != int64(len(want)) || buf.String() != string(want) {
		t.Errorf("%s: Write wrote %q (%d, %v), want %q", name, buf.String(), n, err, want)
	}
}

func TestFusedPersonEqualsConstructThenEncode(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 7, Email: "a@b", Age: 40}

	held := PersonFromUser(&src)
	want, wantErr := held.AppendJSON(nil)
	got, gotErr := AppendPersonJSONFromUser(nil, &src)
	fusedAgainst(t, "Person", got, gotErr, want, wantErr)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	n, err := WritePersonJSONFromUser(&buf, &src)
	writtenAgainst(t, "Person", n, err, &buf, want)
}

func TestFusedRolodexEqualsConstructThenEncode(t *testing.T) {
	src := Account{ID: 4, Contact: "c@d"}

	held := RolodexFromAccount(&src)
	want, wantErr := held.AppendJSON(nil)
	got, gotErr := AppendRolodexJSONFromAccount(nil, &src)
	fusedAgainst(t, "Rolodex", got, gotErr, want, wantErr)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	n, err := WriteRolodexJSONFromAccount(&buf, &src)
	writtenAgainst(t, "Rolodex", n, err, &buf, want)
}

func TestFusedRenamedEqualsConstructThenEncode(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 5, Email: "m@n", Age: 1}

	held := RenamedFromUser(&src)
	want, wantErr := held.AppendJSON(nil)
	got, gotErr := AppendRenamedJSONFromUser(nil, &src)
	fusedAgainst(t, "Renamed", got, gotErr, want, wantErr)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	n, err := WriteRenamedJSONFromUser(&buf, &src)
	writtenAgainst(t, "Renamed", n, err, &buf, want)
}

func TestFusedSparseEqualsConstructThenEncode(t *testing.T) {
	src := Terse{ID: 9}

	held := SparseFromTerse(&src)
	want, wantErr := held.AppendJSON(nil)
	got, gotErr := AppendSparseJSONFromTerse(nil, &src)
	fusedAgainst(t, "Sparse", got, gotErr, want, wantErr)

	var buf bytes.Buffer
	n, err := WriteSparseJSONFromTerse(&buf, &src)
	writtenAgainst(t, "Sparse", n, err, &buf, want)
}
